generation.prompt: Create a high-resolution 16:9 abstract visual source for a live-performance video loop called Aurora Veil. Deep near-black navy background, elegant translucent cyan and violet aurora ribbons flowing horizontally, subtle fine star-like particles, soft volumetric glow, balanced negative space, cinematic but restrained, crisp enough for projection, no horizon, no people, no objects, no logos, no typography, no borders. Compose so a very slow centered breathing zoom can loop without exposing edges. This is a source frame for Synaptome's redistributable public example media.

settings.encode: libx264 preset=slow crf=18; centered cosine breathing zoom 1.02..1.04..1.02; no audio
